name: M7-NOV-01 public prior-art retrieval inputs
selection_rule: Three published papers from distinct scientific areas were selected from primary-source abstracts before observing any product retrieval for these drafts. Each draft states a mechanism already reported by its linked paper without naming its title, authors, DOI, or PMID.
primary_metric: Number of cases whose exact target PMID or DOI appears among the first three returned papers; inspect rank and source IDs, not a model novelty score.

cases.draft_hypothesis: In motor neurons, loss of nuclear TDP-43 may expose a cryptic polyadenylation site in STMN2 pre-mRNA, reducing functional stathmin-2 and impairing axonal regeneration.
cases.source_anchor: Abstract: TDP-43 reduction exposes a cryptic stathmin-2 polyadenylation site, produces truncated nonfunctional mRNA, and stathmin-2 rescue restores axonal regenerative capacity.
cases.scope_note: Cell and patient-neuron evidence; no clinical treatment effect is asserted.

cases.draft_hypothesis: SARS-CoV-2 may require ACE2 engagement and TMPRSS2-mediated spike priming to enter susceptible human cells.
cases.source_anchor: Abstract: SARS-CoV-2 uses ACE2 for cell entry and TMPRSS2 for spike-protein priming.
cases.scope_note: Entry mechanism only; no clinical treatment efficacy is asserted.

cases.draft_hypothesis: In checkpoint-treated mouse tumors, interferon-gamma sensing may induce Qa-1b and restrain CD8 T cells through NKG2A/CD94.
cases.source_anchor: Abstract: IFN-induced Qa-1b inhibits CD8 T cells through the NKG2A/CD94 receptor in checkpoint-treated cancer models.
cases.scope_note: The causal Qa-1b mechanism is in mouse models; HLA-E translation is not claimed.
